items.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'one of Hamilton’s favorite people' in the context of a guest on Jim Cullum's show, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship with Hamilton.

ctx.x: Well it’s made — it has made life more active and more full and it’s already full and busy and this just is another activity. However, it’s something that I wanted to do and have pursued with some vigor to get it to go. But yeah, it is not for the faint of heart this whole thing, I don’t believe. You know you’ve got to be — because it wears you out. It’s a lot going on.

I brought a little piece from one of your shows if I could make it happen here. Oh that’s not it, hold on. I wanted to get it up, I will in a second here, because you had a guest, one of our favorite people, and I did want to try to get it up here. It’s a guessing game but, one of Hamilton’s favorite people.
